description: The user's Substack posts with likes, comments, restacks and word count, plus opens, clicks, views, recipients and the free and paid subscribers the post brought when a Publisher API key is connected. Newest first, from the last sync. `query` filters titles, `since` (YYYY-MM-DD) drops older posts, `type` narrows to newsletter, podcast or thread. If it reports nothing synced, give the user the link it returns rather than guessing.

query.description: Case-insensitive text to match in titles.

since.description: Only posts published on or after this date.

name: get_substack_posts
title: List Substack posts
